subject: MAP draft: Data handling milestones & owners (post-demo recap)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-10T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft: Data handling milestones & owners (post-demo recap)

Maria — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Per our call, I captured a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the data handling / compliance milestones we discussed. Below is a concise recap and proposed owners/target dates — please review and flag anything missing. I will attach a worksheet with the milestones after your initial feedback.

Key objectives (what we talked about):
- Define retention windows for PII/PHI and the mechanism for deletion
- Provide audit logging and export capabilities for compliance reviews
- Scope PHI touchpoints and agree on data minimization approach
- Confirm required evidence (SOC 2, penetration test artifacts) and delivery timeline

Proposed MAP milestones (owner — target):
1) Retention policy agreement (Acme legal) — 2026-03-25
2) Data map + PHI scoping (Acme: Dr. Khan / Redwood: Aditya Rao) — 2026-03-31
3) Audit log schema + export mechanism (Redwood security / Acme infra) — 2026-04-07
4) KMS & key management integration plan (Redwood infra + Acme security) — 2026-04-10
5) Contract addendum (retention & deletion SLA) (Procurement / Redwood legal) — 2026-04-15 (target close)

Dependencies:
- Completed SOC 2 report and redacted artifacts for procurement/legal review
- KMS customer-managed key decision (may shift timelines)
- Procurement window and PO / SOW sign-off

Next steps:
- Rishi: send MAP worksheet (today) — DONE (attached in follow-up)
- Maria: confirm PHI scope and procurement timeline (please reply)
- Aditya: to confirm audit log export formats and retention indexing options

Attachments: acme_map_rishi_v1.xlsx (draft), sample-retention-table.xlsx (example template)

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Thanks Rishi — good summary and thanks for the fast turnaround. A few clarifications from our side before we lock dates:

1) Retention durations — for PHI we need a two-track retention: 0-90d operational cache, and 7 years archival for legal/clinical records unless flagged for deletion earlier. Can you confirm Redwood can support tiered retention windows per dataset?
2) PHI scoping — Samir and I will produce an initial inventory by 2026-03-20 but need a template for the data map (columns/format). The sample-retention-table.xlsx you referenced would be helpful; please attach.
3) SOC 2 — procurement will need the latest SOC 2 Type II report and a statement of where logs are retained (region). Is that something you can provide redacted?

Procurement: procurement@acmehealth.com — once legal signs off on retention language we will need a 4-week procurement window to route the addendum.

Appreciate the ownership notes — please attach the MAP worksheet and an example of the audit log export (schema or CSV sample) so our engineers can validate.

-Maria
Maria Lopez
Head of IT Compliance | Acme Health
maria.lopez@acmehealth.com

Maria — thanks for the clarifying questions. Attached is the MAP worksheet (acme_map_rishi_v1.xlsx) and a short CSV example of the audit log export schema embedded in the worksheet. Responses inline to your points: 

1) Tiered retention: Yes — Redwood supports per-dataset retention tiers. We can configure an operational KV cache TTL (default 90d) and a long-term archival retention (customer-controlled S3 bucket) for up to the 7-year archival window you requested. If you want a shorter archival window for specific datasets we can parameterize that in the MAP.

2) Data map template: added as a tab in the attached worksheet (columns: dataset_name, pii_phi_flag, source_system, retention_tier, encryption_kms, downstream_exports). If you prefer a Figma/diagram export, we can run a quick joint scoping session next week.

3) SOC 2 artifacts: We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a security attestation for where logs are stored (regional S3 buckets US-west-2 by default). I have also attached a separate one-pager describing the audit log schema and available filters (time-range, request-id, user-id).

Updated milestone notes (changes from initial):
- Audit log export: Redwood will provide both live API access for log queries and a daily S3 export (gzipped CSV) that your compliance team can ingest. Owner: Redwood security (Aditya) — target 2026-04-07.
- Deletion SLA: Draft clause included in attached MAP under contract addendum. Target sign-off remains 2026-04-15, but subject to procurement window.

Attachment stub: acme_map_rishi_v1.xlsx (MAP + data map template + log-schema.csv)

Let me know if you want me to schedule a 30-min scoping call next Tue/Wed with Aditya to walk the data map.

Best,
Rishi
